description: Monthly payment, amount financed, total interest, and total cost of a car for an auto loan after down payment and trade-in value are subtracted from the vehicle price. Use when the user is financing a car purchase and wants the payment and total interest. For whether the car fits their budget use calculate_car_affordability; for leasing use calculate_lease_vs_buy. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive auto loan calculator calculator.

include_schedule.description: Set to true to include the yearly amortization schedule.
